columns.name: DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD_ID
columns.description: Primary key. Uniquely identifies a document of record.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_CODE
columns.description: Document Code uniquely identifies record .

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person against whom document has to be stored.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Assignment against whom document has to be stored.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the type of document which is stored. It also determines the document category and subcategory it will be related to.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the document of record. Used in order to differentiate incase multiple documents are added to the same document type.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Number which legally identifies the particular document.

columns.name: DATE_FROM
columns.description: Date from which the document is valid.

columns.name: DATE_TO
columns.description: Date until which the document is valid.

columns.name: ISSUING_COUNTRY
columns.description: Country which has issued the document.

columns.name: ISSUING_LOCATION
columns.description: Location at which document has been issued.

columns.name: ISSUED_DATE
columns.description: Date on which document has been issued.

columns.name: ISSUING_AUTHORITY
columns.description: Designation of person or authority name who has issued the document.

columns.name: RELATED_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the entity whose document is being stored for example Absences.

columns.name: RELATED_OBJECT_ID_COL
columns.description: Attribute name of the entity whose document is being stored e.g. Absence_Id.

columns.name: RELATED_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Actual value of the attribute. E.g. 100001, actual value of Absence_Id.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments pertaining to the Document Record.

columns.name: PUBLISH
columns.description: Indicates whether the document should be published before the start date

columns.name: PUBLISH_DATE
columns.description: Publish date will decide when document should be visible.

columns.name: CREATION_SOURCE
columns.description: Indicates the source of the record creation ie HDL/HSDL/UI/REST etc.

columns.name: TAG_LIST
columns.description:
Tags used to identify document record for class
      ification and grouping.

columns.name: ARCHIVED_BY
columns.description: Indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: ARCHIVE_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
